ingredient_not_found: An ingredient could not be found in your catalogue.
limit: Your catalogue limit has been reached.
items_limit: A list can contain at most 300 distinct item and unit pairs.
conflict: This item has changed. Reload it before trying again; your input is still displayed.
read_only: Restore or reopen this item before editing it.
quantity_range: The calculation must give a quantity between 0.000001 and 1,000,000,000.
template_check: Create a list from this template to check off purchases.
incomplete: Check off every item in a non-empty list before completing it.
metric_recipes_description: First creation of each recipe, including archives; edits do not count again.
metric_lists_description: First completion of each fully purchased list, including archives; reopening does not multiply the result.
metric_imports_description: First import of each list/recipe pair. Imports into templates are excluded.
metric_templates_description: First time each template contains an item, including archives.
web_unavailable: The import browser is unavailable. You can paste the recipe text.
web_invalid_url: Enter a public HTTP or HTTPS address without credentials.
web_session_expired: The browsing session has ended. Open the page again.
web_page_changed: The page changed. Check the preview and try again.
web_busy: An import is already running or the temporary limit has been reached. Try again shortly.
web_page_unavailable: The page could not be loaded. Try again or paste the recipe text.
web_language_changed: Your account language changed. Prepare the import again in the current language.
web_no_recipe: No single usable recipe was found. Check the page or paste the recipe you want.
web_truncated: The page is long: some text was not sent. Check that the recipe is complete.
web_import_conflict: This import was already saved with different content. Open the saved recipe.
web_uncertain_measurements: Some servings, quantities or units need your review. Complete the empty fields using the original lines; ranges are not replaced with an arbitrary value.
item_identity: Provide either a free item (name) or a catalogue ingredient (ingredient_id).
preparation_too_long: The complete preparation is limited to 20,000 characters, including section texts.
